content_sections.text: Other conditions: Excellent communication skills (written and oral) Minimum computing skills Essential: Knowledge of Konkani Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi Electronics: additional qualification such as CCNA, CCP or any other diploma in computer hardware maintenance is recommended Logistics: preference to MBA (Logistics Management) and/or PG Diploma in Logistics Management Media & Entertainment: preferably experience in animation production as a texturing artist

rows.qualification: Degree in Automobile Engineering /Mechanical Engineering from a recognized Institute /University, with at least 1 year work / teaching experience; OR Diploma in Automobile Engineering /Mechanical Engineering from a recognized Institute /University, with at least 3 years work / teaching experience; OR Diploma/Engineer (Mechanical Engineering) from a recognized Institute with minimum 04 years of experience in Automotive Service Industry; Working experience on latest tools and equipments' used for vehicle servicing

Diploma/Degree in Hotel Management from a recognized Institute/University, with at least 5 years' work/teaching experience in Food and Beverage service including one year as supervisory capacity in a classified Hotel or Facility Management Company; OR Certificate in Domain with 5 years sector specific experience; OR Diploma in hotel Management with 5 years sector specific experience; OR Degree in Hotel Management with 5 years sector specific experience; OR Post graduation in Travel & tourism Management or in Tourism and Hospitality from a recognized Institute/University, with at least 1 year work experience; OR Three years degree/diploma after class XII, in Tourism and travel management from any recognized institute of Hotel Management from a recognized Institute/University, with at least 3 year industrial experience

Diploma (GNM (General Nursing Midwifery)) with total experience of 3 years out of which 2 year sector specific experience or 1 year teaching experience; OR B.Sc. Nursing and Midwifery (4 years) or 3½ years Diploma in GNM with one year experience; OR B.Sc (B.Sc. (Nursing)/Post Basic B.sc Nursing) with total experience of 2 years out of which 1 year sector specific experience or 1 year teaching experience; OR Medical Graduate (MBBS, BAMS, BHMS) with total experience of 2 years out of which 1 year sector specific experience or 1 year teaching experience; OR Ph.D. (Nursing) with total experience of 2 years out of which 1 year sector specific experience and 1 year teaching experience; OR M.Sc (Nursing) with total experience of 2 years out of which 1 year sector specific experience or 1 year teaching experience

B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institute/University, with at least 1 year work/Teaching experience; OR Diploma in Civil engineering with 2 year work/teaching experience; OR Diploma in Civil Engineering with 03 years of experience out of which 2 years sectors specific experience and 0-1 year teaching experience

Graduate or Diploma in Logistics Management, P.G. Diploma in Logistics Management with at least 50% marks and 1 year work or teaching experience in the area of logistics; OR Graduate with 02 years subject specific experience in Logistics Sector

B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Electronics/Telecommunication with one year experience in the relevant field OR Diploma in Electrical/Electronics/Telecommunication from recognized board of technical education with two years experience in relevant field; OR B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Technology OR Master of Computer Science OR Master of Computer Application OR Master of Information Technology OR DOEACC B Level Certificate; OR B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Technology/Electronics and Communication OR Master of Computer Science OR Master of Computer Application OR Master of Information Technology OR DOEACC B Level Certificate; OR 3 years Diploma (Polytechnic from Gov. recognized university) with 5 years of Experience in Consumer Electronics and 1 year sector specific experience; OR Engineer Graduate or higher degree in the listed electronics/computer/electrical/mechanical branches with 1 year sector specific experience; OR Polytechnic Diploma in the listed computer/electronics/electrical/mechatronics branches with 3 years of Exp.

Post-graduation in Agriculture/Horticulture from a recognized Institute/University with at least 01 year work experience; OR Graduate (Agriculture / Horticulture / Forestry) with 1 years sector specific experience

Graduate in any stream from a reputed Institute/Effective communication organization with at least 1 year of experience in the Media & Entertainment industry, preferably in animation production as a texturing artist

content_sections.text: All original documents in support of qualification Passport size photograph Age proof / Birth Certificate Address proof Valid residence certificate for 15 years Valid employment registration certificate / Employment Exchange Card; passing certificates and mark sheets; sports and extra-curricular certificates, if any; one set of copies

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Goa Samagra Shiksha Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Address the application to the State Project Director, Goa Samagra Shiksha, Secondary Education, Directorate of Education, Porvorim. Submit the application with the necessary documents on the day of the interview. Submit a separate application for each sector if applying for more than one sector. Report at 9.45 am at the Directorate of Education, Porvorim Goa with original documents. Submit one set of copies of the certificates to the interview panel. Attend on 12 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Separate application for each sector when applying for more than one sector No Travelling allowance is admissible for candidates attending the walk-in interview The authority reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any time without any prior notice Only eligible candidates fulfilling the criteria shall apply

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Goa Samagra Shiksha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Goa Samagra Shiksha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 12 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview for Goa Samagra Shiksha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Directorate of Education, Porvorim Goa.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 20,000 per month (consolidated) for Instructor (Automobile), Rs. 20,000 per month (consolidated) for Instructor (Tourism & Hospitality), Rs. 20,000 per month (consolidated) for Instructor (Healthcare), Rs. 20,000 per month (consolidated) for Instructor (Plumbing), Rs. 20,000 per month (consolidated) for Instructor (Logistics).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Sector-wise qualification for 13 NSQF sectors. The options range from 12th Pass with 04 years of sector specific experience (Retail) to Diploma, Degree, B.Tech, Post-graduation, MBBS/BAMS/BHMS or Ph.D. (Nursing), each with the work or teaching experience the notice prints. Knowledge of Konkani is essential. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Excellent communication skills (written and oral). Minimum computing skills. Essential: Knowledge of Konkani.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who fail to produce the requisite original and valid certificates/documents when called upon shall be eliminated. Candidature of a shortlisted candidate shall be rejected any time if found ineligible at document verification.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Verification of original certificates/documents during the walk-in interview. Walk-in interview before an interview panel.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on a contract basis till the end of the Academic year 2026-27 (i.e. 31st March 2027). Transferrable anywhere in Goa.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by Goa Samagra Shiksha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Government & Aided High Schools and Government & Aided Higher Secondary Schools, Goa, Transferrable anywhere in Goa.
